guarantees.claim: On each posedge of clk_i, if reset is active (!rst_ni) then cyc_ctr_q is assigned 3'd0; otherwise cyc_ctr_q is assigned the value of cyc_ctr_d.

uncertain_points.claim: The 3-bit register cyc_ctr_q can overflow if the combinational input cyc_ctr_d ever takes a value greater than 7; no overflow protection is visible in this register block.
uncertain_points.risk: The cycle counter wraps to a small value, corrupting the round counter state inside the AES cipher control FSM, potentially causing repeated rounds, skipped rounds, or missequencing that may leak key material or lead to incorrect cryptographic output.
